Replayed, dropped, aborted or forged/cross-owner receipts cannot publish; identical-valued unrelated grids and A-to-B-to-A edits are rejected.
Recipe/provider reload, world/menu/block replacement, source or destination mutation and reentrant same-owner operations invalidate or exclude a pending operation.
Unsupported, NoMatch, MatchedEmpty, Prepared, Refused and conflicting claims preserve explicit selection/stop semantics and existing recipe order.
Matching/placement denial, limited crafting and authority failure cannot be overridden by a product proposal; no-provider path has native behavior and no new snapshots.
Late remainder failure, invalid output/count, holes/crop mapping failure and unsupported native value abort the whole pair before native storage or effects.
Preparation/allocation RNG draws and native hooks are staged/deferred or have an explicit tested abort/order contract; copied Menu data alone is not a rollback.
Staged output/remainders retain complete native stack identity, unknown/UTF16 fields and runtime state; current recursive retained-wire refusal remains conservative.
Normal and right-click slot200 reach the new operation despite menu_ops bypass, transfer full native result and consume the same pair.
Cursor compatible/incompatible/full and allowed inventory/drop destinations are preflighted using actual finished output identity and limits, without using mutating give as a dry run.
Legacy shift fallback reachability is established; no live duplication bug is inferred from an isolated source branch.
Pickup, quick move, swap, throw and carried-bundle extraction validate before any output leaves; crafting pickup-all remains excluded.
QuickMove loop: each successful craft uses one new pair; no movement, exhausted inputs, output mismatch or cancelled later iterations cannot replay earlier pairs.
Menu session Some(false) and partial candidate failures cannot leak output, grid edits, events or unjournaled side effects.
Late native_prepare_item_craft output replacement invalidates only the affected preview and cannot splice old remainder data into a later take.
Authenticated inventory and table clicks preserve state-ID/menu lifetime/spectator/table-range checks and exact authoritative copy-back.
Prediction has no authority; stale/replayed/reordered requests, disconnect/reconnect and world change never grant duplicate products.
Stateful preview versus action-time output has explicit full-stack resynchronization and supported-client behavior; no silently changed wire format.
No client-supplied output/remainder pair or value-equal grid can replace server preparation; slot hashes are not commit authorization.
Same pair spans real block/trigger lifetime, all neighboring target allocation, output/remainder ejection and input decrement.
Native allowed drop/ejection policy is retained when neighbor storage is full; unsupported or failing publication is rejected before partial effects.
Map finalization, saved-map registration, RNG, event callbacks and reentrant neighbor behavior share a proved effect boundary or refuse custom paired processing before effects.
Repeated scheduled ticks, removed/replaced blocks, disabled slots and target changes cannot reuse a previous receipt.
No-provider vanilla shaped/shapeless/special map, banner duplication, book cloning and recipe ordering remain unchanged.
Event identity/count/order, statistics, advancement ingredients, tutorial signals and awarded output use the exact selected/committed pair.
Existing complete-plan guards reject earlier cancellation/later resurrection or competing replacement that bypasses paired authority; no weakening by installation order.
Source-derived Overslime policy preserves tool metadata and used/unused bottle mapping; all IDs/formulas remain TConstruct-owned.
Independent catalyst/fresh-output policy exercises the same generic contract without TConstruct schemas; synthetic evidence is labeled.
